categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three main business segments: LNG application equipment, heavy equipment manufacturing, and LNG processing, operation, and sales services. Its product portfolio includes liquefaction plant devices, LNG/CNG refueling station equipment, cryogenic transport vehicles, LNG storage tanks, LNG supply systems for vehicles and ships, cryogenic valves, chemical and marine heavy equipment, and LNG operation services. The company also focuses on energy service operations and overseas market expansion.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced cryogenic technology for LNG liquefaction, storage, and transportation, including vacuum insulated pressure vessels and specialized valves. It employs proprietary manufacturing processes for large-scale pressure vessels and heavy equipment, with certifications such as ASME and various international maritime class certifications. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on hydrogen fuel cell vehicle supply systems, LNG cold energy recovery, and digital transformation including smart control systems and automation in production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include heavy truck manufacturers (e.g., FAW Jiefang, Dongfeng Commercial Vehicle, China National Heavy Duty Truck), oil and gas companies (PetroChina, Sinopec, CNOOC), global energy giants (Shell, ExxonMobil, BP, Total), air separation companies (Air Liquide, AP, Linde), and EPC contractors (Fluor, JGC, Samsung, Hyundai). The company serves industries such as transportation, energy infrastructure, chemical processing, and marine sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic market share, especially in LNG heavy truck supply systems and energy services. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and projects in Japan, Australia, Brazil, Singapore, Spain, and other international markets. The company actively pursues global LNG infrastructure and heavy equipment markets, including Asia, Europe, South America, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the LNG and energy equipment supply chain. It manufactures core LNG liquefaction and storage equipment, heavy industrial equipment, and provides LNG operation and maintenance services. It acts as a key equipment supplier and service provider to end users and EPC contractors in the LNG and energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding LNG application equipment market share, enhancing heavy equipment manufacturing capabilities, and growing LNG operation services domestically and internationally. The company emphasizes R&D in hydrogen fuel cell vehicle supply systems, LNG cold energy recovery, digital transformation, and smart manufacturing. It also focuses on cost reduction, automation, and intelligent product lifecycle management to improve competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of LNG equipment, heavy industrial equipment, and LNG-related products. Additionally, the company earns income from LNG sales and operation & maintenance services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, including bidding and negotiated contracts with industrial and energy customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's LNG equipment manufacturing and energy service sectors, with strong brand recognition and a broad customer base including global energy majors. It competes with domestic and international manufacturers of cryogenic and heavy industrial equipment. Its comprehensive LNG full-industry-chain solutions and overseas market penetration differentiate it from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 3.32 billion, a 9.34% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 219 million, up 49.02%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding LNG heavy truck markets and overseas heavy equipment orders. Total assets stood at about RMB 4.05 billion with a net asset increase of 15.58%. R&D investment was RMB 110 million, about 3.31% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers integrated LNG full-industry-chain equipment and energy operation services, combining advanced cryogenic technology, heavy equipment manufacturing, and intelligent control systems. Its products are certified to international standards and tailored for high efficiency, safety, and environmental compliance. The company emphasizes technological innovation, product quality, and customer service to provide reliable, cost-effective, and customized solutions that support clients' low-carbon energy transition and operational efficiency.
